integrity: All 331776 labeled profiles are exhaustively replayed with exact rational arithmetic. Random-priority ordinal efficiency is tested with the published acyclicity criterion, and stochastic dominance is checked at every rank cutoff.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the balanced four-agent, four-object random-assignment domain with complete strict preferences and uniform random priority; no larger-market frequency formula is claimed.
title: Exact four-agent efficiency census for random priority versus probabilistic serial
